CISCO Centre of Excellence for Advanced Networking

The Department of Computer Sciences Engineering had signed MoU with CISCO Systems, Bangalore on 21-01-2018. The CISCO center of excellence on Advanced Networking available in the department provides world-class networking infrastructure. The faculty members have been constantly trained by CISCO Networking Academy, to offer the latest industry-relevant networking curriculum. The Department is offering the certification course CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate) to the students since 2018. The course provides practical hands-on experience to the students on networking concepts during the 110 hours of the course.

As per the CISCO requirements, the CCNA course is divided into the following four modules:
  • Networking fundamentals
  • Routing protocols and concepts
  • LAN switching and wireless
  • Accessing the WAN

The CISCO Centre of Excellence is equipped with sophisticated CISCO hardware like routers, switches, wireless adapter, cables and PCs to effectively deliver the CISCO CCNA curriculum. Packet tracer software is also installed in computers to simulate the various network configurations and provide a better understanding of the networking concepts.

The following equipment are available in the Cisco Centre of Excellence at ATME College of Engineering.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="VLSI Incubation with FrenusTech Pvt. Ltd., Bengaluru" tab_id="1652183635255-ea944783-e8ef"][vc_column_text]

ATME as per an MOU with FrenusTech Pvt. Ltd., Bengaluru, has herewith created a Tier-ii training center for FrenusTech at its campus. The training center is being set up in order to train fresh recruits hired by FrenusTech. In this regard, students from ATME as well as from other institutions are being trained at this establishment. Additionally, the incubation will be utilized for providing training/workshops for ATMECE faculties on the VLSI domain.

Beneficiaries
  1. Final and Pre-final year students of ATMECE / other institutions
  2. Faculty of ATMECE / other institutions.

Software & Equipment
  1. Server  – HP 280 G3 Base Model PCI Microtower PC – 16GB RAM, 2TB HDD, Core i7 – Centos 7
  2. Clients 30 no’s – HP 280 G3 MT, 8GB RAM,1TB HDD, Core i5, CentOS 7,
  3. 30 users – Cadence Tools for PG training package
  4. 10Mbps internet connectivity
  5. Biometric Door Access for 24×7 lab access

Utilization
  1. VLSI training for FrenusTech Pvt. Ltd., trainees – Weekly 35 Hours
  2. VLSI training\workshops for Faculty of ATME – As per Workshop schedule
  3. Internship for Pre-final year students – 4 Week internship
  4. Design and Development of Projects for FrenusTech
